rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion to a narrow, venue-channeling holding that treats retailers’ harms as too derivative to qualify as being “adversely affected” for § 387l(a)(1) venue, drawing on National Ass’n of Manufacturers and U.S. v. Texas. Thomas is likely to write alone in dissent on the breadth of “any person adversely affected,” while one or more majority justices may add short concurrences to emphasize either textual limits or anti-forum-shopping/administrability concerns.
